status: All persistence/corpus gates passed; standalone WebKit ephemeral OPFS failures reproduced and fresh persistent-profile probe passed
method: Single-sample real-browser OPFS durability and same-corpus raw comparator diagnostics; synthetic original spike3 geometry, 10,003 files / 92,687,646 bytes. No upstream package payload.

environment.timingCaveat: Noisy diagnostic timings: owner activity and nonzero host load observed. One sample per engine, no performance threshold or cross-machine comparison.

source.note: Chromium/Firefox and Safari compiled different committed fixture revisions; only production OPFS byte identity is asserted.

measurementNotes: persistMs uses per-256-file background backend.checkpoint(); native payload fsync count is asserted zero.
One explicit backend.flush(file path) is measured separately and asserts exactly one native payload fsync.
Backend close performs workspace-wide payload fsync outside persistMs, before reload and before raw comparator.

Raw comparator writes the same file/directory graph and byte contents with 32 native create/write/close workers, one final minimal path/size manifest snapshot and no payload fsync; the adapter emits 40 checkpoints plus an initial empty baseline.

Native async call duration sums overlap under concurrency and cannot be added as critical-path time. Untimed snapshot checksumming, tree validation, cloning and truncate costs are not individually attributed.

Adapter nativeTimings accumulates from backend open through the separately measured one-file flush; persistBatches contains only storage.persist spans. Raw comparator counters are reset before its isolated measurement.
